profile.subtitleJa: ユダに属する町でイスラエル王とユダ王が対面した場所
profile.summaryJa: 列王記下14:11は、ユダに属するベト・シェメシュでイスラエル王ヨアシュとユダ王アマツヤが向かい合ったと記します。

primaryWitnesses.textualBasisJa: But Amaziah would not listen. So Jehoash king of Israel went up; and he and Amaziah king of Judah looked one another in the face at Beth Shemesh, which belongs to Judah.

Jehoash king of Israel took Amaziah king of Judah, the son of Jehoash the son of Ahaziah, at Beth Shemesh and came to Jerusalem, then broke down the wall of Jerusalem from the gate of Ephraim to the corner gate, four hundred cubits.
